flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate moved up moderately, and the Democrats remain the favoured party. In [[Michigan]], the Democrat Abdul El-Sayed saw a sizable rise in their chances. Republicans also gained ground in [[Iowa]], where Ashley Hinson's chances climbed sizably, and in [[Nebraska]], where Pete Ricketts moved up by a similar amount.
summaries.governor: The biggest move came in [[Nebraska]], where the Republican Jim Pillen saw a sharp rise in Polymarket odds. In [[Georgia]], the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms gained a sizable amount of ground, and the market treats the race as a predicted flip. Moderate gains for the Republicans Greg Abbott and Byron Donalds also showed up in Texas and Florida.
summaries.house: The biggest move is in [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], where the Republican Brad Knott saw a sharp drop in chances against the Democrat Paul Barringer. In [[FL-09 (Orlando & Kissimmee)]], the Republican Dan Green edged up slightly against the Democrat Darren Soto, and the market still lists it as a predicted flip. The projected House count now stands at 239-196, up from 238-197, with [[WI-01 (Kenosha & Racine)]] newly predicted to flip, and the result is that Democrats gain control.
